text: {"action_items": [{"title": "Review rollback notes (including schema migration step) and post explicit approval or required changes in release channel", "owner": "Dan", "deadline": "2025-09-25"}, {"title": "Update clarification on database rollback step in rollback notes", "owner": "Mina", "deadline": null}, {"title": "Deploy patch to production after Dan's explicit approval in release channel", "owner": "Mina", "deadline": null}, {"title": "Revisit deployment window if changes to rollback notes are required", "owner": "Ravi", "deadline": null}], "decisions": ["Testing and approval are separate conditions; staging test results do not satisfy approval requirement.", "No production deployment occurs before Dan's explicit approval message in the release channel.", "Mina will hold deployment until explicit approval appears; she will not deploy based on assumptions or test results alone.", "Dan will not treat test results as approval; approval must be explicit."], "open_questions": ["Database rollback step needs clarification (schema migration step to be included).", "Whether the rollback notes are acceptable pending Dan's review."]}
